title: Authority of Scripture
definition: The authority of Scripture means that the Bible, as the written Word of God, is the final standard for faith, doctrine, correction, and obedient living.
summary: Because Scripture is God-breathed, it speaks with God’s authority. Believers are called to receive the Word humbly, test every teaching by it, obey what God has commanded, and center their lives on Christ, who perfectly reveals the Father. The authority of Scripture protects the Church from human opinion and keeps disciples anchored in God’s truth.

studySections.heading: Scripture as Final Authority
studySections.content: The authority of Scripture means that God’s Word stands above human tradition, personal experience, cultural pressure, and theological preference. All teaching must be tested by the written Word of God.

studySections.heading: Christ and the Word
studySections.content: Jesus honored, fulfilled, quoted, and obeyed Scripture. His own use of Scripture shows believers how to submit to God’s Word. The authority of Scripture leads us to Christ, not away from Him.

studySections.heading: Obedience to the Word
studySections.content: The right response to Scripture is faith-filled obedience. God’s Word is not given merely to be studied, but to be believed, obeyed, proclaimed, and lived out through dependence on the Holy Spirit.
